name: Elkhart County, IN
findings: Elkhart County has 601 nonprofit organizations. 246 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 184 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Elkhart County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Elkhart County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 13 education organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do education organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 61 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 61 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few youth organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 2 youth organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
